decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing complements the enterprise voice portfolio and is cheap to keep running, even though it faces strong competition from over-the-top collaboration tools.
Metro data centre connectivity is a core growth area for a carrier like Colt and already shows adoption by financial-hub customers.
Optical spectrum services use the firm's existing fibre infrastructure and are prominently featured on their own page, signalling strategic importance.
A number ordering portal is a low-cost digital self-service tool that supports the voice business and improves customer efficiency.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service, but it still generates revenue from the existing customer base and costs little to maintain in the short term.
Direct voice network connection serves enterprise SIP and voice interconnect needs that align with the firm's core business.
